title: Arrays
description: Learn to recognize, derive, implement, and analyze arrays patterns.

sections.title: Recognition and core idea
sections.markdown:
## When to recognize this pattern
Look for contiguous indexed data, repeated work, or a prompt whose constraints rule out a quadratic scan.

## Core idea
An array stores a contiguous logical sequence with O(1) index access. Search is O(n); an insert or delete near the front is O(n) because later elements shift. Prefix data supports two-pass queries, while in-place scans reduce extra storage.
key_points: State the invariant before choosing code.

sections.title: From naive to better
sections.learning_objective: Derive the optimized approach from a baseline.
sections.markdown:
## Naive approach
Start with two-pass. It may be easy to verify, but it repeats work and becomes too slow as input grows. State its cost before optimizing.

## Better approach
Use prefix sums and in-place scans. The optimization is valid only if the invariant proves discarded work cannot affect the answer. Never quote a complexity without identifying the operation that dominates it.

sections.title: Python implementation
sections.markdown:
## Python implementation
The implementation below keeps the invariant visible and avoids clever shortcuts. Trace it before memorizing it.

## Step-by-step example
Use the shown input. Record the important pointer, state, or table after each iteration and verify that the final output is `6`.

examples.code:
nums = [3, 1, 4, 1, 5]
prefix = [0]
for value in nums:
    prefix.append(prefix[-1] + value)
print(prefix[4] - prefix[1])

sections.title: Complexity and common mistakes
sections.markdown:
## Time complexity
O(n) preprocessing and O(1) range queries. Explain whether sorting or preprocessing is included.

## Space complexity
O(n) for the prefix array. Input storage does not count as auxiliary space unless copied.

## Common mistakes
Using the pattern without its precondition, moving state in the wrong order, missing empty input, mishandling duplicates, and reporting average-case cost as a guarantee. For recursion, include call-stack space; for a DP table or hash map, count stored states.
key_points: Time: O(n) preprocessing and O(1) range queries.
Space: O(n) for the prefix array.
